social_circle.name: Paula Whitaker

demographics.education: associate degree in medical office administration

background.how_they_met: Paula is Iris and Frank's daughter, raised in their Covington-area family home.
background.why_close: They are in frequent contact, and Paula is the child Iris relies on most for medical paperwork, online health information, family updates, and emotional conversation.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in clear full sentences, often with quick practical questions, appointment reminders, and family photos. Uses a few heart and prayer emojis but keeps messages concise during work hours.

shared_activities: occasional errands near Covington and Conyers
recent_text_topics: Checking whether Iris and Frank have scheduled upcoming doctor and dental appointments.
Helping Iris compare prescription refill details and look up plain-language vaccine guidance.
Coordinating a family meal and asking which pie the grandchildren want next time they visit.
Talking about racial justice and local politics in a cautious but more open way than Iris has with many church friends.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Paula lives near Conyers, works in a medical office, and Iris talks to her several times a week. Q36 says Paula helps Iris look over medical paperwork. Q42 says Paula helps Iris look up CDC information. Q44 says Iris told Paula when she was upset about a friend's stroke. Q29 says Iris talks with Paula about race and policing.

social_circle.name: Carol Bennett

background.how_they_met: Carol is Iris's younger sister; they grew up together near Covington in the same farming family.
background.why_close: They share childhood memories, family recipes, health worries, Southern Baptist faith, and a habit of direct emotional support.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Uses short, familiar texts with full words rather than slang. Often sends recipe notes, appointment updates, and 'call me when you sit down' messages.

shared_activities: talking about family and doctor appointments
recent_text_topics: Comparing notes on arthritis stiffness, breathing trouble, and upcoming appointments.
Trading recipes for greens, biscuits, and lighter versions of old family dishes.
Planning a monthly visit around a birthday and asking who needs help with food.
Nighttime worry check-ins when Iris feels lonely or unsettled.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 explicitly says Iris has a younger sister, Carol, in Griffin and that they talk every few days about family, recipes, and doctor appointments, seeing each other about once a month. Q35 says Iris worries about her sister's breathing trouble. Q38 and Q49 say Iris calls Carol when stressed or in a tough moment.

social_circle.name: Mark Trujillo

demographics.occupation: maintenance supervisor for a manufacturing plant

background.how_they_met: Mark is Iris and Frank's son, raised in their Georgia home before moving to Alabama with his wife and sons.
background.why_close: Although he is less emotionally verbal, he stays connected through Sunday calls, family updates, sports, and Iris's concern for his work stress and boys.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts briefly, often one-line updates or photos of the boys. He is more likely to call on Sundays than write long messages, but he replies reliably.

recent_text_topics: Updates about his boys' school, sports, and summer plans.
Checking whether Iris and Frank need anything fixed during the next visit.
Brief Braves comments when a game is on and Frank is watching too.
Iris gently asking how work is going because Mark tends to get quiet when stressed.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Mark is Iris's grown son, lives in Alabama with his wife and boys, and usually calls on Sunday evenings. Q46 says Mark works hard and tends to get quiet when stressed. Q05 also says Iris keeps up with grandchildren through texts, video calls, and birthdays.

social_circle.name: Linda McAllister

recent_text_topics: Coordinating casseroles and soup for a church family after illness.
Following up on the close church friend who had a stroke and how her husband is managing.
Prayer requests for older church members living alone.
Reminding each other not to overcommit to every church event.

Q47 says Iris is active in church, Bible study, women's ministry, senior outreach, and meal support. Q49 says Linda is one of the people Iris would call in a tough moment.

social_circle.name: Ruth Parker

background.how_they_met: Ruth and Iris met through the senior center and became close through volunteering, book club overlap, and Thursday senior bowling nights.
background.why_close: They share the same rhythm of low-impact activities, senior-center service, books, humor, and mutual check-ins when someone misses an activity.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts casually but politely, sometimes using exclamation points and a laughing emoji. She sends reminders, small jokes, and 'are you coming Thursday?' messages.

recent_text_topics: Confirming whether Iris is coming to Thursday senior bowling and joking that bowling is mostly laughing.
Swapping book club opinions and asking whether Miss Evelyn needs a ride.
Checking on Iris's knee after arthritis flares or long standing shifts.
Discussing senior center phone workshops and whether they should attend together.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 names Ruth from the senior center as one of Iris's closest friends and says they meet for coffee, trade books, and check on each other if someone misses bowling night. Q15 says Iris has senior center volunteering, book club, and Thursday senior bowling. Q91-Q92 mention library or senior center technology classes and phone workshops.
